review_rules: Early-series terminology must be dated and must not be silently normalized to later definitions.
Where Arena or Daggerfall presents a concept differently from later games, preserve both historical representations.
Developer recollections about early production remain development-history evidence rather than replacements for shipped material.
Track later reuse and reinterpretation of early concepts as separate adoption links.
Do not infer modern province or racial lore backward into early texts without explicit evidence.
